'''Zhou Tonghui''' ({{zh|c=周同惠|p=Zhōu Tónghuì}}; November 8, 1924 – February 23, 2020) was a Chinese [[Analytical chemistry|analytical chemist]] and academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS).<ref>{{cite news|author1=Hou Jingjing ({{lang|zh|侯婧婧}})|url=https://new.qq.com/omn/20200224/20200224A09JUU00 |script-title=zh:95岁分析化学家周同惠院士病逝，曾建立中国兴奋剂检测中心 |work=Tencent |date=24 February 2020 |access-date=25 February 2020 |language=zh}}</ref>

==Biography==
Zhou was born in [[Beijing]], on November 8, 1924, while his [[Ancestral home (Chinese)|ancestral home]] was in [[Guilin]], [[Guangxi]]. He attended Pingmin Primary School Affiliated Beiping Normal University. He elementary studied at the Middle School affiliated to Beiping Normal University and secondary studied at the High school affiliated to {{ill|Chinese-France University|zh|中法大学}}. In 1944 he graduated from [[Peking University]]. After graduation, he taught at the university. In 1948, he went to the United States to study at the [[University of Washington]], where he earned his [[Master of Science]] degree and [[Doctor of Philosophy]] degree under the supervision of Robinson. From 1952 to 1953 he was an assistant professor at the Department of chemistry, [[University of Kansas]]. In the summer of 1953, he joined the Burroughs Wekkcomeco as a researcher.<ref>{{cite news|author1=Qi Wang ({{lang|zh|戚望}})|url=http://news.sina.com.cn/c/2020-02-24/doc-iimxxstf4097487.shtml |script-title=zh:中国科学院院士周同惠逝世，享年95岁 |work=sina |date=24 February 2020 |access-date=25 February 2020 |language=zh}}</ref>

In 1954, Zhou and other students jointly wrote letters to the then [[President of the United States]] [[Dwight D. Eisenhower]] and the then [[Secretary-General of the United Nations]] [[Dag Hammarskjöld]], requesting to return to China. In 1955, he and other students jointly wrote to [[Premier of the People's Republic of China|Premier]] [[Zhou Enlai]], who was then meeting in [[Geneva]], asking the Chinese government to come forward and negotiate with the U.S. government. Finally, the U.S. government agreed to let Chinese students leave the United States on the condition of returning American prisoners of the [[Korean War]]. In June 1955, he left the United States by boat and returned to [[Beijing]] in July.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.sohu.com/a/375567836_100144123 |script-title=zh:桂林痛失一科学巨匠！曾为我国建立兴奋剂检测中心！|work=Sohu |date=24 February 2020 |access-date=25 February 2020 |language=zh}}</ref> In September of the same year, he was assigned to the Department of Pharmacology of National Health Research Institute (now [[Peking Union Medical College|Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences]]) as an associate researcher. He joined the [[Chinese Communist Party]] in 1986.{{citation needed|date=October 2023}}

He died of illness at {{ill|Beijing Friendship Hospital|zh|首都医科大学附属北京友谊医院}}, on February 23, 2020, aged 95.<ref>{{cite news|editor1=Liu Jia'ni ({{lang|zh|刘佳妮}})|url=http://www.bjnews.com.cn/news/2020/02/24/693937.html |script-title=zh:中国科学院院士周同惠因病逝世，享年95岁 |work=Beijing News |date=24 February 2020 |access-date=25 February 2020 |language=zh}}</ref>

==Honours and awards==
* 1991 State Science and Technology Progress Award (First Class)
* 1991 Member of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS)<ref>{{cite news|url=https://tech.sina.com.cn/roll/2020-02-25/doc-iimxyqvz5556540.shtml |script-title=zh:周同惠院士逝世 |work=sina |date=25 February 2020 |access-date=25 February 2020 |language=zh}}</ref>
